round2.parameter_snapshot_note: v1 parameters.npz contains diagnostic joint edits due to CPU NumPy sharing; original prediction.npz is intact. parameters_forward_restored.npz restores forward-equivalent joints from original predictions; each full objective replay checked within 1e-5. Raw axis norms and optimizer state are not reconstructed.
round2.metric_version_note: v2 axis metric normalizes both vectors in float64 and uses atan2(cross,abs(dot)); v1 float32 acos values retained as legacy_metrics. Pivot metric uses unit GT axis. This corrects a small-angle numerical floor, not the large pivot/state bias.

arti4d.scope: One original Arti4D white-box cue; 25x512 core pilot, Q6/P4/M128, 2000 steps, three seeds; input GMSF from 25x4096
arti4d.gt_scope: Only axis and pivot line available; no state MAE or segmentation mIoU
arti4d.selection: Within each variant minimum total objective seed; within run largest-supported moving candidate before GT
